item: 9.2 (2026-11-25): the effort slider is set by an __effort frame — the level the CLI runs on after the plugin's start-up re-apply of the saved pick, pushed again on every page load — instead of staying on its fixed High
branch: js/70-events.js the __effort arm (setEffortUI) · Kotlin side ClaudeSessionService.startCli / shownEffort, ChatPanel.seedUi
provenance: The __effort frame is the plugin's own (ClaudeSessionService pushes it from get_settings.applied.effort, whose shape was measured on 2.1.332 in _local/probe-effort-persist/); it never comes from the CLI.
